summary.text: Grant Campbell is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 83 who has served since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A physician and U.S. Army veteran, he earned his bachelor's and medical degrees at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

paragraphs.text: Campbell was born in Sanford, North Carolina, and earned a bachelor's degree in 1993 and an M.D. in 1997, both from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
He served in the U.S. Army from 2008 to 2017 and works as a physician.

He has served on the board of directors of The Independence Fund and of the University of North Carolina General Alumni Association, and is a life member of Veterans of Foreign Wars and a member of the American Legion.
Campbell assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2025, succeeding Kevin Crutchfield.
The General Assembly's website lists him as representing Cabarrus and Rowan counties.
In the 2025-2026 session he is a member of the Appropriations, Appropriations, Health and Human Services, Health, and Homeland Security and Military and Veterans Affairs committees, among others.
